_comment: Soba Tower QA run. Use URL http://localhost:3001/?lives=1 . The game steps exactly 1/60 s per scripted frame (window.advanceTime test clock in main.js), so the run is deterministic and all 3 iterations are identical. Start from the title (or retry from Results) with ArrowRight, steer left onto the garden trellis, let it climb itself to 18 m (score 180), then tap right so Soba steps off the trellis into the empty drop zone (x 114-148) and falls below the screen: with ?lives=1 that is game over (mode game_over, Results screen). The tap works for 6-16 frames at any start offset (node sim). 491 frames per iteration.

steps._comment: Any arrow starts the climb / retries
Fade in; Soba bounces on the street (score stays 0)
The trellis climbs itself to 18 m
Tap right: step off the trellis into the drop zone
Fall below the screen -> game over -> Results
